The thesis has two steps. Step 1 is the next confirmed daily cycle low, at any price. Step 2 is either a higher daily cycle low or a bullish daily trend-line break.

Here is what has happened.
- The 1 Oct daily cycle low failed on 21 Oct, when GOOG closed below it on the daily.
- A new daily cycle low was confirmed, dated 5 Nov and known on 11 Nov. That was before you set the condition on 19 Nov, so it doesn't count for step 1.
- That 5 Nov low then failed too, with a daily close below it on 19 Nov. That also happened before the challenge condition was set on 20 Nov, so it doesn't count toward the challenge.

GOOG is currently inside its weekly cycle low window. The window opened 26 Oct, is centred around 23 Nov and closes around 4 Jan. Those window dates are engine estimates and unverified.

Step 1 needs a confirmed daily cycle low dated after 5 Nov, and it has to become known after the condition was set. Once that happens, step 2 is checked. Step 2 needs either a higher daily cycle low or a bullish daily trend-line break. If both are met, the thesis is complete.

The thesis is challenged by a daily close below the latest confirmed daily cycle low. That only counts if it happens after the challenge was set on 20 Nov.

No plan was captured for this revision, and there's no last close in the data.

This describes what has happened and what would meet each step. It is not a forecast or advice.
